title: Altars
summary: Altars were places of sacrifice, worship, thanksgiving, remembrance, and covenant response.
background: From the patriarchs to the tabernacle and temple, altars marked encounters with God and acts of worship. They often connect memory, sacrifice, and surrender.
teachingHelp: When an altar appears, ask what response to God is being shown: worship, repentance, thanksgiving, or covenant obedience.
